user_story: As a guest, I want to cancel my booking so that I can free up the reservation.

positive.title: Cancel a booking successfully
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest user.
Select an active booking from the list.
Click on the cancel option available for the selected booking.
Confirm the cancellation action in the popup/modal dialog.
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully canceled, and a confirmation message is displayed to the user, updating the booking status to 'Canceled'.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a non-existent booking
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest user.
Attempt to cancel a booking ID that does not exist in the user's booking list (simulated via URL manipulation or API call).
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking cannot be found or canceled.

edge.title: Cancel a booking made very close to the cancellation deadline
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest user.
Select a booking that is scheduled to start in less than an hour.
edge.expected_result: The system processes the cancellation without errors, or gracefully handles and informs the user if cancellations are not permissible within the set deadline, displaying an appropriate message.
